tests.title: Add To Cart refuses a quantity above online stock, including what is already in the cart
tests.goal: The eShop never lets a customer put more units in the cart than are available online.
preconditions: product test 2 has a small known online stock N (sum of the Online Shop warehouses in CRM Inventory; 52 on 2026-10-27)
data: N read from CRM Inventory > View by Variants (Office + TaiPo + IFC Warehouse + 半島倉)

steps.text: As a guest with an empty cart open product test 2
Set quantity N+1 and click Add To Cart
Set quantity 9 and click Add To Cart
Set quantity N-8 and click Add To Cart

expected.text: Step 2: "Not enough quantity for this product"; cart badge unchanged (0)
Step 4: "Not enough quantity for this product"; badge stays 9

checks.label: Step 2: "Not enough quantity for this product"; cart badge unchanged (0)
Step 4: "Not enough quantity for this product"; badge stays 9

notes: product test 2: 52 accepted, 53 refused ("Not enough quantity for this product"); 9 in cart + 60 refused.

tests.title: Checkout accepts the quantity that Add To Cart accepted
tests.goal: Product page and checkout agree on how many units can be bought.
preconditions: product test 2 has more online stock in total than in TaiPo Warehouse alone (e.g. Office 44, TaiPo 8)

steps.text: As a guest with an empty cart open product test 2, set quantity Q, click Add To Cart -> Expect: "Item added successfully"
Open /checkout and look at the product test 2 line

expected.text: No "Not enough stock" on the line; Sub. Total = unit price x Q
If the stock cannot fulfil Q, step 1 must already refuse it with the available quantity

checks.label: No "Not enough stock" on the line; Sub. Total = unit price x Q
If the stock cannot fulfil Q, step 1 must already refuse it with the available quantity

notes: 2026-10-27: 9 and 52 show "Not enough stock" (TaiPo 8). Evidence re-taken 2026-10-28 with TaiPo 9: qty 10 accepted by Add To Cart, checkout line "Not enough stock"; cart emptied.
Recorded 2026-10-28 for the 2026-10-27 evening exploration (promotions, stock limits).
